description: This file contains utility functions for handling object permission updates within a software project, particularly involving database interactions via a Prisma client. It includes functions for attaching permissions to data dictionaries, updating or creating permission records, and managing permission-related data for objects like keys, teams, and organizations.

methods.name: Dict attach_object_permission_to_dict( data_dict: Dict, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Attaches an object permission to a dictionary if 'object_permission_id' exists by querying the database.

methods.name: Optional[str] handle_update_object_permission_common( data_json: Dict, existing_object_permission_id: Optional[str], prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
methods.description: Handles updating or inserting object permission records, merging new permission data with existing ones, and upserting into the database.

methods.name: _set_object_permission( data_json: dict, prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
methods.description: Creates an object permission record in the database from provided permission data within a dictionary.

ctags.name: handle_update_object_permission_common
ctags.signature: ( data_json: Dict, existing_object_permission_id: Optional[str], prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
